info.title: Backend Promotor API
info.description: API documentation for Backend Promotor project

post.description: Creates a new campaign with the provided data

put.description: Updates a campaign with the provided data

delete.description: Soft deletes a campaign by ID

get.summary: Get active campaign for a promoter
get.description: Returns the active campaign for a promoter based on the current datetime (between START_TIME and END_TIME). The response includes campaign details with a rotas array, where each rota contains its associated oficina details.

200.description: Active campaign found or no active campaign

get.description: Returns a list of all campaigns (non-deleted)
Returns a campaign by ID with its relationships (promoters with their routes and oficinas, and questions)
Returns all campaigns for a specific client with relationships (promoters with their routes and oficinas, and questions)

post.description: Creates a new question for a campaign with the provided data

put.description: Updates a campaign question with the provided data

delete.description: Soft deletes a campaign question by ID

get.description: Returns a list of all campaign questions (non-deleted)
Returns a campaign question by ID

post.description: Saves a new campaign result or updates if a result already exists for the given ID_ROTA and ID_PERGUNTA

put.description: Updates an existing campaign result by ID

get.description: Returns a campaign result by ID with its relationships (rota and pergunta)

get.summary: Get campaign results by rota ID
get.description: Returns all campaign results for a specific rota

get.summary: Get campaign results by campanha ID
get.description: Returns all campaign results for a specific campanha

post.description: Authenticates a promoter with email and password, returning a JWT token
Creates a new promoter with the provided data

put.description: Updates a promoter with the provided data

delete.description: Soft deletes a promoter by ID

get.description: Returns a list of all promoters (non-deleted, without passwords)
Returns a promoter by ID (without password)

post.description: Creates a relationship between a promoter and one or more campaigns

delete.description: Remove relationship between a promoter and one or more campaigns

get.summary: Get all campaign IDs linked to a promoter
get.description: Returns an array of campaign IDs linked to the given promoter
Returns a list of all promotors for a specific client ID (without passwords)

post.description: Creates one or multiple routes for a campaign promoter. Can receive a single ID_OFICINA or an array of ID_OFICINA for batch creation.

Creates a campaign promoter (CAMPANHA_PROMOTOR) and its associated routes with workshops. Receives ID_PROMOTOR, ID_CAMPANHA and an array of ID_OFICINA. First creates the CAMPANHA_PROMOTOR record, then creates ROTA_PROMOTOR records for each workshop.

201.description: Campaign promoter and routes created successfully

put.description: Updates workshops for a route (campaign promoter). Soft deletes old workshop links that are no longer needed and creates new ones. Receives ID_CAMPANHA_PROMOTOR and an array of ID_OFICINA.
Updates a route's options (not the workshops). Can update STATUS, SUCCESS, CHECKIN_TIME, DONE_AT, and OBS. All fields are optional in the request body.

get.description: Returns a route by ID with its relationships (campaign promoter, campaign, promoter, and results).

post.description: Returns latitude and longitude for a given CEP (postal code).

get.description: Returns the nearest oficinas based on latitude and longitude coordinates. Uses the Haversine formula to calculate distances. Returns up to 40 results by default (customizable via limit parameter).
